section_flow.notes: Fixed full-bleed looping sky video at 80% opacity with a soft gradient mix-blend-overlay scrim on top — sits beneath the whole site as ethereal backdrop.
Black-bg video splash on first load with 'Skip Intro' rounded glass pill; 800ms opacity transition to dismiss.
Primary-color thin bar with shipping incentive + tap-to-apply promo code (QUEEN15) + close button.
Sticky white-glass nav with Pinyon Script 'Rich Queen' wordmark (32px) above tiny tracked 'Beauty Supply' eyebrow; horizontal link list + filled shopping bag icon with badge counter.

Circular brand logo with white border + cyan shadow glow at center, pixie-dust particle layer floating around it, headline below in Manrope semibold + dual rounded-full CTAs (Shop Collection + Royal Runway 3D).
Glass band with 21:9 aspect image card; pulsing play icon + tertiary pill 'Enter 3D Interactive Runway'.
Three aspect-square photo cards (Lip Care / Haircare / Skincare) with bottom gradient overlay + italic Bodoni headline + uppercase 'Shop Now ->' label.
3xl rounded card with lipgloss video at 55% right + dark primary gradient mask; left text block in white type with 'Claim Your Crown' italic display + glass white CTA pill.
Featured products in a horizontal scroll-snap carousel with rounded circle prev/next chevron buttons.
Eyebrow + italic Bodoni headline + two long Manrope paragraphs on white-30% glass overlay.
Three glass-card reviews with 5 tertiary-color filled stars, italic quote, avatar circle initial + name + 'Verified Buyer'.
Free Shipping / Secure Checkout / Premium Quality / Easy Returns four-column with Material Symbols icon + uppercase label + tiny subline.
Hidden hash-routed shop page: 280px sticky filter sidebar (product type / price / brand) + sort dropdown + 3-col product grid; mobile gets bottom-right FAB opening a filter drawer.

Hash-routed page running a Three.js WebGL carousel: ornate gold-extruded frames + bevel + corner flourishes, 6 product textures arranged on a radius circle with shadow floor + ACES tone-mapping + gold particle system. Drag to spin, fallback view if WebGL blocked.
Sticky image column + breadcrumb + variant chip selector + qty stepper + Add to Bag pill + related-products grid.
Cart line items with stepper + remove; mobile sticky checkout bar fixed above bottom-nav with Bodoni total.

hero_signature: Cyan-mint background sky with sky_video_bg looping at 80% beneath everything. A circular logo orb (192-256px) sits centered, surrounded by a pixie_dust_container with 4-color floating particles that float up and sparkle on randomized 1.5-3s intervals. Below: italic Bodoni Moda script + paragraph + dual rounded-full CTAs. The brand wordmark above is Pinyon Script — cursive, hand-lettered.
notable_features: Three.js WebGL 3D runway carousel with ornate extruded gold frames + bevel + bezier flourishes + ACES filmic tone-mapping + gold particle system
Sky video as fixed background layer that scrolls behind the whole site
Splash intro video overlay with skip button (one-time dismiss)
Pinyon Script cursive secondary font for brand wordmark + italic display fragments
Pixie dust particle generator: spawns random radius+color radial dots and floats them up via floatUp + sparkleAnim keyframes
Headless ecommerce: hash-routed SPA with /, /shop, /product, /cart, /runway views
Material Symbols Outlined for all icons (variable font with FILL axis)
Glass-card and glass-card-strong utilities with backdrop-blur
Vapor-shadow utility (long-throw colored drop shadow in primary tone)
Mobile sticky checkout bar with Bodoni total + tertiary CTA
Floating filter FAB on mobile that opens a right-side drawer
Custom token system with named container hierarchy (surface / surface-dim / surface-container-low/high/highest)
motion_vocabulary: fadeInUp + fadeIn keyframes for content reveal
floatUp particle keyframe (translateY -120px + scale 0.2 + rotate 180deg + opacity in/out)
sparkleAnim drop-shadow brightness pulse for individual particles
animate-on-scroll class with is-visible toggle via IntersectionObserver
Hover scale-105 on category cards, scale-110 on shop logo, -translate-y-1 on glass-card hover
Three.js carousel auto-rotates with momentum, drag-to-spin, ease-into-target
tailwind_extras_inline_css: .glass-card / .glass-card-strong (white 60-75% + backdrop-blur 16-20px + soft white border), .vapor-shadow (long colored drop-shadow in primary tone), .cloud-bg + .ethereal-bg gradient backgrounds, .text-display / .text-headline / .text-title / .text-body-lg / .text-label / .text-button typography scale with Bodoni Moda for display, .pixie-particle with stacked floatUp + sparkleAnim animations, .filter-fab + .filter-drawer + .filter-drawer-panel drawer system, .carousel-3d-section + .carousel-3d-container WebGL canvas containers, .mobile-checkout-bar sticky band with safe-area-inset-bottom padding.
